_description: Viral (and one mycoplasma) reference genomes screened for in the unmapped RNA-seq reads. Accessions checked against NCBI esummary on 2026-10-26.

references.label: Hepatitis B virus
references.note: Reference is genotype D (ayw); genotypes common in East Asia (B, C) differ by up to 8%, so exact 25-mer matching misses many of those infections.

references.label: Human papillomavirus 16
references.note: Only HPV16, 18 and 45 are in the panel; other HPV types are not detected.

references.label: Human papillomavirus 18
references.note: Only HPV16, 18 and 45 are in the panel; other HPV types are not detected.

references.label: Human papillomavirus 45
references.note: Only HPV16, 18 and 45 are in the panel; other HPV types are not detected.

references.label: Simian virus 40
references.note: SV40 promoter and polyA signals are in many plasmid vectors; a hit confined to those regions is a vector, not an infection (check breadth).

references.label: Human adenovirus 5
references.note: HEK293-derived and adenovirus-transformed lines carry adenovirus 5 DNA.

references.label: XMRV (mouse retrovirus)
references.note: Culture contaminant from mouse xenograft passage; shares sequence with MoMLV.

references.label: Moloney murine leukemia virus
references.note: Also the backbone of retroviral vectors (LTRs); a narrow hit can be a vector.

references.label: Mycoplasma hyorhinis
references.note: Culture contaminant. Bacterial mRNA has no polyA tail, so polyA-selected RNA-seq undercounts it; presence is informative, absence is weak evidence.
